bcr.title: Block Custom Rules
bcr.help: Mod options — the top line wins, over every resource pack rule.
bcr.empty: No lines yet — add a block or tag below (e.g. minecraft:cobweb, #minecraft:crops[age=7]).
bcr.cmd.reloaded: Reloaded the mod options (%s rule files, %s block states with rules). Use F3 + T for resource packs.
bcr.cmd.reload_failed: Could not read the config file; keeping the previous rules (see the log).
bcr.problem.json_syntax: JSON syntax error: %s — the whole file is skipped.
bcr.problem.format_unsupported: Unknown format %s (this version reads %s) — the file is skipped.
bcr.problem.unknown_block: No block called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_biome: No biome called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_entity: No entity type called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_tag: No tag or group called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.combinator_alone: %s must be the only field of its object.
bcr.problem.no_fields: No value fields — this line does nothing.
bcr.problem.group_cycle: Group %s refers back to itself — the loop is read as empty.
bcr.problem.bad_value.cull_pass: cull_pass must be true, false or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.sway: sway must be a number from 0 to 5 or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.sound_category: sound_category must be a name like "ns:name" or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.replace: replace must be true or false: %s
bcr.cmd.tags_not_ready: server tags not loaded yet (title screen)
bcr.cmd.no_target: Look at a block or give one: /bcr rule minecraft:wheat[age=7]
bcr.toast.title: Block Custom Rules
bcr.problem.bad_value.sway_blend_seconds: sway_blend_seconds must be a number from 0 to 5: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.problem_toast: problem_toast must be true or false: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.footsteps: footsteps must be true or false: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.action: An action entry must be {"parent": "action"} or {"parent": null}: %s
bcr.problem.category_cycle: Sound category %s is its own parent through a loop — the loop is cut.
bcr.debug.blocked: blocked — the footstep engine plays it
bcr.debug.reason.no_foot_block: kept: no block under the feet matches
bcr.debug.reason.keep: kept: the block has no sound category
bcr.debug.reason.protected_source: kept: master · ui · music from the server
bcr.debug.reason.not_owner: kept: the block here does not make this sound
bcr.debug.reason.not_defined: kept: no such name in any pack
bcr.cmd.debug_on: Sound debugger on — radius %s, %s. Run /bcr debug sound again to turn it off.
bcr.cmd.debug_bad_mode: Mode must be blocks, all or blocked.
bcr.cmd.names_head: Sound category %s — name found for each sound (green = its own, yellow = from a parent):
bcr.cmd.tag_none: %s — no such block tag or group (%s).
bcr.cmd.tag_head: %s — %s blocks in the end (server tag with every pack / mod-option override applied):
bcr.cmd.tag_no_server: Base: no server tag (pack / mod-option groups only)
bcr.cmd.template_copied: Copied %s missing names of %s to the clipboard (sounds.json of that namespace) — each points at the sound heard now.
bcr.problem.structures: structures cannot be checked on the client (structure data is not sent) — the line is skipped.
bcr.problem.unknown_spot: Unknown spot or channel %s (ground, top, bottom, through, enter, exit, footwear, chime, mob, *).
bcr.problem.bad_value.channel: Channel values must be numbers from 0 to %2$s: %1$s
bcr.problem.layer_line: A layer line needs exactly one of "sound" or "include".
bcr.problem.layer_cycle: Layer %s includes itself through a loop — the loop is cut.
bcr.problem.bad_value.range: Must be a number or [min, max] (0 or more): %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.size_scaling: size_scaling must be true or false: %s
bcr.help.rules: Higher wins — mod options > upper packs > lower packs · scroll, click [+] to expand.
bcr.help.categories: A higher pack replaces the same name wholesale (dim = overridden) · click [+] to expand.
bcr.help.layers: A higher pack replaces the same name wholesale (dim = overridden) · click [+] to expand.
bcr.help.mix: Every matching line applies in order; per channel the higher line wins · add lists accumulate.
bcr.help.entities: Per field the higher line wins · click [+] to expand.
bcr.lookup.head.categories: sound.categories · actions — sound types · action names
bcr.lookup.head.layers: sound.defaults · layers — default ranges · layered sounds
bcr.lookup.head.mix: sound.mix — volume · pitch · delay · add by spot, action, weather
bcr.lookup.options_head: Mod options — top layer · upper line wins · saved on Done
bcr.lookup.packs_head: Resource pack rules (read only) — upper pack wins · later file · later line wins
bcr.lookup.before_join: Not connected — tag and biome conditions resolve after joining a server.
bcr.lookup.none: No rule file defines this section.
bcr.lookup.copy_tip: Copy to the top of mod options — press Done to save.
